name: Analyze Ebv Antibody Titers
description: Analyze ELISA data to quantify EBV antibody titers in plasma/serum samples.
detailed_description: Analyze ELISA data to quantify EBV antibody titers in plasma/serum samples.
when_to_use: When you need analyze ebv antibody titers analysis

parameters.raw_od_data: [Required] Dictionary containing optical density (OD) readings for each sample. Format: {sample_id: {'VCA_IgG': float, 'VCA_IgM': float, 'EA_IgG': float, 'EA_IgM': float, 'EBNA1_IgG': float, 'EBNA1_IgM': float}} (dict)
parameters.standard_curve_data: [Required] Dictionary containing standard curve data for each antibody type. Format: {antibody_type: [(concentration, OD), ...]} (dict)
parameters.sample_metadata: [Required] Dictionary containing metadata for each sample. Format: {sample_id: {'group': str, 'collection_date': str}} (dict)
